notes: Audit of 13 records on 2026-10-11 against awarding-body/government official pages only. Bucket counts: recurring_next_intake_expected = 10 (ids 36, 110, 183, 224, 280, 310, 334, 384, 570, 622); temporarily_closed_awaiting_announcement = 1 (id 680); genuinely_discontinued = 0; upcoming_or_current_intake = 0; uncertain = 2 (ids 420, 720). Reviewer must-know items: (1) id 36 - www.esteri.it/en/opportunita/borse-di-studio returned 404 and the studyinitaly ListaBandi banner still cites the '2025-2026' call as closed while the FAQ references the 2026-2027 Call; the Dhaka embassy confirms the AY 2026-2027 round concluded (final ranking published 3 June 2026). (2) id 110 - the A2A portal scheme page returns HTTP 500, so the current round's open/closed state on the portal could not be read; classification rests on ICCR's own schemes page stating the scheme runs 'only for AY 2025-26 to 2027-28', i.e. through AY 2027-28. (3) id 224 - FWF states 'Currently no submissions' with formal announcement each June; next-round dates not published. (4) id 680 - QU explicitly states international-student application dates 'have not yet been determined' for Spring 2027. (5) ids 420 and 720 are low-confidence 'uncertain': 420's NAWA page is frozen on the 2021/22 edition and 720's TSLS scheme page 404s with no status published anywhere readable. No records qualified as genuinely discontinued: no official page states any programme has ended, been withdrawn or absorbed. All logo URLs were fetched and verified to render from the awarding body's own domain; logos are null for ids 224, 334, 384 and 622 because no official-domain logo/image URL appeared in the fetched page content (Serbia's page uses inline SVG placeholders only). No deadlines, amounts, departments, statuses or URLs were invented; unverifiable fields are null with the reason recorded in page_evidence.
